FIRST ADDENDUM 
 Th e first addendum (th is “ Addendum ”) to the IT Services Agreement dated [• DATE ] [• MONTH ] 2024 (the “ Agreement ”) is made and entered into at Lahore on this [•DATE] day of this [•MONTH] 2024, by and between: 
 
 ZAMEEN MEDIA (PRIVATE) LIMITED , trading as Zameen.com, a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan, with its registered office at Pearl One, 94 B/I, M. M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, acting through its duly authorised representative Mr. Adil Ahmad Kamal (“ Zameen ” which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns) 
 AND 
 
 [• CUSTOMER ] , a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan, with its registered office at [•] acting through its duly authorised representative [•] ( “ Customer ” which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns) 
 
 Zameen and the Customer shall also individually be referred to as “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ” . 
 
 WHEREAS 
 
 The Parties entered into the Agreement for provision of digital marketing solutions and services with respect to real estate project under taken by the Customer, named and styled as ‘ [•PROJECT NAME]’ , comprising of [•] residential plots, [•] commercial plots and [•] constructed houses based on an area of [•] and located at [•LOCATION ] (“ Project ”); and 
 
 Pursuant to Clause 20.6 of the Agreement, Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Agreement as per the provisions of this Addendum. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows: 
 
 Th is Addendum shall be effective from [•] (“ Effective Date ”). 
 
 The Parties hereby understand and agree that for the purposes of the Agreement a ‘ Matured Lead ’ shall be any Lead who deposits thirty percent ( 30% ) of the Sale Price of a Unit sold to such Lead. For the avoidance of doubt, t he Service Fee under the Agreement shall be payable with respect to such Matured Leads only. 
 
 The Parties understand and agree that under clause 8.1 of the Agreement , the Customer shall be liable to pay twelve percent (12%) of the Quoted Price of the Unit as Service Fee for every Matured Lead. 
 
 Customer hereby undertakes to pay Zameen , the Services Fee , in the following manner: 
 
 Customer shall pay four percent (4%) of the Quoted Price to Zameen on payment of ten percent (10%) of the Sale Price by the Buyer; 
 
 Customer shall pay a further four percent (4%) of the Quoted Price to Zameen on payment of further ten percent (10%) of the Sale Price by the Buyer, taking the aggregate payment/instalment(s) to twenty percent (20%) of the Sale Price; 
 
 Customer shall pay a further four percent (4%) of the Quoted Price, along with the Premium (if any) due under the terms of this Agreement, to Zameen on payment of further ten percent (10%) of the Sale Price by the Buyer, taking the aggregate payment/instalment(s) to thirty percent (30%) of the Sale Price. 
 
 This Addendum shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement. 
 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning in this Addendum, unless otherwise specified. 
 
 Any conflicting terms in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately to give effect to the intention of the Parties herein. 
 
 All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of the Agreement shall prevail. 
 
 This Addendum may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same. 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this Addendum , having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.

 For and on behalf of CUSTOMER
